headline: Google launches a cheaper alternative to large AI security models like Mythos

story_facts.headline: Google launches a cheaper alternative to large AI security models like Mythos
story_facts.plain_language_summary: Google is launching Gemini 3.6 Flash alongside a new security model dedicated to quickly finding and patching security vulnerabilities. In a blog post on Tuesday, Google describes Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber as a "cost-efficient and highly capable alternative" to larger, more expensive AI systems, such as the one offered by Anthropic's Mythos.
